llm_analysis.bug_bounty_draft:
**Title:** Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Protection)
**Severity:** Critical
**Vulnerability Type:** CWE-1021
**Target Asset:** https://coe.dsce.ac.in/

**Description:**
The X-Frame-Options header indicates whether a browser should be allowed to render a page in a <frame>, <iframe>, or <embed>.

**Evidence:**
```
Header 'X-Frame-Options' not defined in HTTP response.
```

**Remediation:**
Set: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN).

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Protection)
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Frame-Options' not defined in HTTP response.
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options header indicates whether a browser should be allowed to render a page in a <frame>, <iframe>, or <embed>.
findings.impact: Adversaries could frame the endpoint on a malicious site and perform UI redress / clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing or Weak X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Lacks 'nosniff' directive, allowing browsers to MIME-sniff response bodies and execute malicious payloads masquerading as static files.
findings.impact: Increases risk of drive-by download attacks and XSS via uploaded files served with generic MIME types.
findings.remediation: Set: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

findings.title: Web Server / Technology Banner Exposed
findings.remediation: Configure reverse proxies or web servers to strip diagnostic technology banners.

findings.title: Server Banner Version Disclosure: 'Apache'
findings.description: The Server response header discloses specific web server software and version numbers, aiding threat reconnaissance.
findings.impact: Adversaries can tailor specific CVE search queries against the revealed server release.
findings.remediation: Suppress or genericize the Server header in web server configuration (e.g. ServerTokens Prod).

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: Controls how much referrer information is sent along with requests, preventing URI token and query parameter leakage.
findings.impact: Sensitive query string parameters (session tokens, email addresses) may leak to external domains in the HTTP Referer header.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' was absent in the HTTP response.
findings.description: Content Security Policy helps detect and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), data injection, and unauthorized frame embedding.
findings.impact: Increases vulnerability to stored/reflected XSS and unauthorized malicious script execution.
findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, e.g.: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none';

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.evidence:
HTTP Response Headers:
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 05:32:31 GMT
Server: Apache
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) enforces HTTPS connections for modern browsers, protecting users against SSL-stripping and man-in-the-middle attacks.
findings.impact: Users visiting the site over insecure public Wi-Fi can have their initial plaintext HTTP request intercepted before redirection.
findings.remediation: Add header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload
